_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored — never commit it.

openai._model_note: gpt-image-1 was shut down 2026-10-23. gpt-image-2.6-sunburst is the current default and the better of the 2.6 pair for precise edits; gpt-image-2.6-flare is faster and cheaper.
openai._size_note: Both edges must divide by 16, so 1080x1350 cannot be requested. 1536x1920 is exactly 4:5 and downscales cleanly to the 1080x1350 the site wants.
openai._fidelity_note: input_fidelity is deliberately NOT sent: on the 2.x models it is always high, and passing it is documented as an error.

output._note: The site builds a 1080x1350 canvas and uploads JPEG at 0.88 quality; we match that exactly.
